assets.title: Mosswood Verge
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single still illustration for a mobile incremental expedition RPG's sector header, wide 16:9 landscape composition, intended canvas 1536 x 864.
Reference image: camp-concept.png is the visual style reference, not an edit target. Draw a new place in the exact same illustrated world; match its ink handling, parchment ground, restrained moss-grey and charcoal palette, sparse hatching and graphic silhouette quality. Do not copy its people or camp into this scene.
Scene: An overgrown forest perimeter at the edge of cleared ground. A disused service road graded flat runs through it. Squat timber survey posts stand along the road with marks cut into their faces. A collapsed lattice relay mast lies half-swallowed by growth. Low mist, wet ground, quiet.
Art style: confident hand-inked shapes, sparse woodcut hatching, dark graphic silhouette masses against muted bone paper, like a considered pen-and-ink indie RPG rulebook illustration. Restrained palette charcoal #20251F, moss-grey, parchment #E8E1CE, tiny muted ochre accent. Strong, readable shapes at phone size. Crisp shapes, generous negative space, subject occupying the central band. Background sparse, no busy environment. No text, typography, UI, panel borders, numbers, watermarks, glowing magic, photorealism, glossy 3D, anime faces, or decorative fantasy ornament. No people. This is art direction for a place, not a character study; no animation.
Composition for delivery: this full-bleed 16:9 artwork will be displayed at phone size and center-cropped to about 2.3:1. Keep essential narrative shapes clear within the central safe band, with disposable headroom and lower margin, no framing lines or inset panels. Keep the quiet road, a few squat posts, and the fallen lattice mast all clearly legible within the middle 70% of image height. The incisions in the posts are simple non-alphabetic nicks, not lettering or numerals. Open mist and plain paper separate the dark foliage masses; do not fill the image with tiny leaves. The mast is fallen horizontally, not standing.

Make ONE targeted change: completely remove the distant upright tower AND all the smaller architectural ruins and spires on the far right hillside. Replace that entire distant built-up hillside with simple low grey woodland silhouettes dissolving into low pale mist. There must be no towers, buildings, bridges or other distant structures whatsoever. The fallen lattice mast is the only metal structure. Keep generous quiet pale mist in the background, do not add more detail. Keep the wet graded service road and post incisions, no actual letters or numbers. No people, text, UI, borders, watermarks, glowing magic or new objects. Maintain the wide full-bleed 16:9 landscape canvas and existing composition.
